definitions.explanation: A male child in relation to their parents. This is the neutral/humble form used when referring to one's own son.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧です。
examples.english: My son is a university student.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{息子|むすこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}します→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧。
examples.english: My son will get married next year.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{高校生|こうこうせい}→高校生：01580_koukousei⟧です。
examples.english: My son is currently a high school student.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何歳|なんさい}→何歳：17594_nansai⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.notes: 息子さん is used when referring to someone else's son

notes:
{息子|むすこ} means 'son' and is used humbly when referring to one's own son.

POLITENESS LEVELS:
- {息子|むすこ}: my son (humble, for own)
- {息子|むすこ}さん: your/someone's son (polite, for others')
- ⟦ご{子息|しそく}→子息：28912_shisoku⟧: your son (very formal/honorific)

RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
- ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧: daughter
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧: child/children
- ⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧: eldest son
- ⟦{次男|じなん}→次男：13210_jinan⟧: second son

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧{息子|むすこ}: only son
- {息子|むすこ}のように: like a son
